products.text:
Type: metal picture ledge shelf
Use: displaying frames, art and books; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or desk
Style: minimalist, industrial, modern
Materials: powder-coated steel, matte finish
Colors: matte black
Shape: long narrow U-channel ledge, raised front lip, flat back plate with visible screws, slim and low, light visual weight
Feel: clean, graphic, understated
Goes with: white or light walls, black frames, light wood; minimalist, industrial or Scandinavian rooms

Type: two-seat rolled-arm loveseat
Use: sitting, lounging, relaxing; living room, family room, den
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, loose cushions, dark wood block feet
Colors: dark indigo blue, dark brown feet
Shape: rounded rolled arms, two plush back cushions, two seat cushions, skirted-style base rail, short square tapered feet, deep and cushy, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, inviting, comfortable, relaxed
Goes with: white or cream walls, warm wood, brass, patterned rugs; traditional, transitional or coastal living rooms

Type: low TV console with cubbies
Use: holding a TV, media devices and storage; living room, bedroom, den
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: engineered wood, black laminate finish
Colors: solid black
Shape: rectangular open-shelf console, six open cubbies and adjustable center shelves, cable holes, plinth base, flat top, boxy and solid
Feel: practical, sleek, grounded
Goes with: grey or white walls, dark wood, metal accents; modern or minimalist living rooms

Type: writing desk with drawer
Use: working, writing, laptop use; home office, bedroom, living room
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: wood-look oak veneer top, black metal frame
Colors: light weathered grey oak, black
Shape: rectangular top with full-width front drawer, slim bar pull, thin square steel legs with low stretchers, open and light, compact
Feel: clean, airy, functional
Goes with: light wood, black accents, white walls; industrial, Scandinavian or modern home offices

Type: framed typography wall art
Use: wall decoration; dining room, living room, kitchen-adjacent dining nook
Style: farmhouse, rustic, retro
Materials: printed canvas, distressed whitewashed wood frame
Colors: black, off-white, white frame
Shape: tall vertical rectangle, bold stacked wine-name lettering, ornate crest borders top and bottom, wide frame, vintage sign look
Feel: charming, vintage, graphic
Goes with: white walls, reclaimed wood, black metal; farmhouse, rustic or bistro-style dining rooms

Type: upholstered accent armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, reading nook
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, glam
Materials: velvet upholstery with zigzag stitching, black metal frame, brass-tipped feet
Colors: cool slate blue-grey, black, brass
Shape: tall padded back, angular wing-like arms, loose seat cushion, slim black steel legs with gold caps, sculptural, medium size
Feel: elegant, soft, refined
Goes with: walnut wood, brass accents, white or charcoal walls; mid-century or modern living rooms
